newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanxi Sanwei applies to offer A, B shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanxi Sanwei applies to offer A, B shares.

text.p: Polyester maker Shanxi Sanwei Group Co Ltd plans to issue 50 million A shares this year, followed by an offer of 150 million B shares, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The company, based in Hongtong in northern Shanxi province, has not decided where it will apply to list the shares, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
If the offers are approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the firm plans to use the shares proceeds to expand its production facilities, he said.
The company has 160 million outstanding shares, consisting of 153 million state shares and seven million legal person shares, the official said.
Sanwei expected to post an after-tax profit of some 50 million yuan in 1996, compared with an unaudited profit of 60 million yuan in 1995 and 30 million yuan the previous year, he said.
